吴姜押着被勾魂索绑得结结实实的色鬼，大步朝着朱宏的办公处走去，远远就看到朱宏正坐在桌前，低头整理着卷宗。

“哈哈哈，老弟，可算盼着你来了！听说你上次可是威风了，区区鬼卒境初期，居然能跟着一起收拾了恶鬼，听说还起了关键作用，能耐不小啊！”

朱宏一抬眼瞥见吴姜，立马放下卷宗，笑着起身打趣。

“朱宏大哥，你就别打趣我了，我就是跟着打了个酱油，都是几位一等鬼差的功劳。”吴姜笑着摆了摆手，又接着说道：“大哥，我是来交任务的，在阳间抓了一个作恶的厉鬼，还是个色胚，刚见到他的时候，正附身在凡人身上干那龌龊事呢。”

朱宏目光扫过一旁瑟瑟发抖连头都不敢抬的色鬼，眉头微挑，随即冷笑着点了点头：“交给我吧，他吃苦的日子刚来呢。”

一听这话，色鬼吓得浑身抖得更厉害，喉咙里发出呜咽似的求饶声，眼神里的恐惧都快溢出来，恨不得当场跪下来磕头。

朱宏手脚麻利地做好交接手续，将色鬼交给一旁待命的小鬼差押走，又转头看向吴姜，正要说话，吴姜却先开口了：

“大哥，我就不逗留了，阳间那边还有事情等着我呢！等小弟有空，再给大哥烧点纸钱下来。”

吴姜说完，朝着朱宏拱了拱手。

“哈哈哈，好，那大哥就不留你了，下次再来，大哥请你尝尝地府的好酒！”

两人互相打了个哈哈，吴姜不再耽搁，转身朝着阴阳通道的方向快步走去。

再次睁开眼时，吴姜的魂体已然归位，随着熟悉的暖流涌过，吴姜感受了一下，发现又精进了少许的境界，忍不住咧嘴傻笑了一下，这才发动车子，朝着普安寺的方向驶去。

吴姜起初还纠结，为啥每次只有他抓了鬼，能得到这种境界精进的奖励，久而久之，他现在已经不纠结了。

管他呢，反正对自己有好处就是了。

将车子停在普安寺门口，吴姜看了一下时间，已经晚上十一点多了。

给余振东发了条消息，很快，寺门“吱呀”一声被打开了。

一大帮子人围了上来。

Wu Jiang escorted the pervert who was tied tightly with the seduction rope and strode towards Zhu Hong's office. From a distance, he saw Zhu Hong sitting at the table, lowering his head and sorting out the files.

"Hahaha, brother, I've been waiting for you to come! I heard that you were so impressive last time. You were able to deal with the evil ghosts together at the early stage of the Ghost Soldier Realm. I heard that you also played a key role. You are quite capable!"

As soon as Zhu Hong raised his eyes and caught a glimpse of Wu Jiang, he immediately put down the file, stood up with a smile and joked.

"Brother Zhu Hong, please stop teasing me. I just followed suit, and it's all thanks to a few first-class ghosts." Wu Jiang waved his hand with a smile, and then said: "Brother, I'm here to hand over a task. I captured an evil ghost in the world of the world. He was also a pervert. When I first saw him, he was possessing mortals and doing dirty things."

Zhu Hong glanced at the trembling pervert beside him, who didn't even dare to raise his head. He raised his eyebrows slightly, and then nodded with a sneer: "Leave it to me, his hard days have just come."

Upon hearing this, the pervert was so frightened that his whole body trembled even more, and he made a whimper-like cry for mercy from his throat. The fear in his eyes almost overflowed, and he wished he could kneel down and kowtow on the spot.

Zhu Hong quickly completed the handover procedure and handed the pervert to the kid on standby to take him away. He then turned to look at Wu Jiang. Just as he was about to speak, Wu Jiang spoke first:

"Brother, I won't stay any longer. I still have things waiting for me in the world of the sun! When I'm free, I can burn some paper money for my eldest brother."

After Wu Jiang finished speaking, he cupped his hands towards Zhu Hong.

"Hahaha, okay, then big brother won't keep you. Next time you come back, big brother will treat you to a taste of the good wine from the underworld!"

The two of them laughed at each other, and Wu Jiang no longer delayed, turned around and walked quickly towards the Yin-Yang passage.

When he opened his eyes again, Wu Jiang's soul had returned to its original position. As the familiar warm current surged through him, Wu Jiang felt it and found that he had improved a little. He couldn't help but grinned, then started the car and drove in the direction of Pu'an Temple.

Wu Jiang was still confused at first as to why he was the only one who could get such a reward for improving his realm every time he caught a ghost. Over time, he no longer struggled.

No matter what, it's good for you anyway.

Parking the car at the entrance of Pu'an Temple, Wu Jiang looked at the time and saw that it was already past eleven o'clock in the evening.

I sent a message to Yu Zhendong, and soon, the temple door opened with a creak.

A large group of people gathered around.
